name: Collapsiblock
description: Makes individual blocks collapsible, with configurable default states, remembered via a cookie.
project_description:
Collapsiblock makes all individual Drupal blocks collapsible. To show/hide the content of a block just click on its title.

 When configured: the last state of blocks is saved in a cookie for each user.

 This module is intended for site-builders who are new to Drupal with relatively simple needs. We try to accomodate feature requests and options but will balance those with the need for a simple UI.

 Blocks open and close with a slide animation, powered by the lightweight

 alexmcarthur/slide-element library (bundled in) - no jQuery required.

 For menu blocks you can keep the active trail open, so a block containing a

 link to the current page stays expanded. Uncheck that setting if you'd rather

 it behaved like any other block.
